newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson says bid surprised Great Western.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson says bid surprised Great Western.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co Chief Executive Charles Rinehart said on CNBC Tuesday that Great Western Financial Corp Chief Executive John Maher was surprised by Ahmanson's $6 billion bid for Great Western.
Rinehart said he spoke to Maher last night.
"I think he was basically surprised and at that stage pretty much noncommittal," Rinehart told an interviewer.
Rinehart quoted Maher as saying he had not had a chance to talk to his board and would need time for such consultations.
Rinehart said there had been off-and-on "conversations" between the two companies over the last couple of years.
He said Ahmanson was making the move because the timing was right for what he called a "compelling deal."
He said a merger would produce annual cost savings of more than $400 million.
